item.text:
**Bottom Line**  
AMLO’s 2024 record is more competent-professional than patronage-based on the evidence I found, but the proof is mostly official and self-reported. The strongest positive evidence is the IMSS-Bienestar federalization: basification of health workers, specialist hiring, and expanded staffing under formal rules. The main negative evidence is election-period timing of social transfers and the lack of strong independent 2024 audits showing how cleanly these systems were managed.

**Positive**
- **IMSS-Bienestar se consolida con egreso, contratación de especialistas y basificación de personal** | IMSS | 2024-02-27 | [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202402/095.) | The IMSS said 2024 would be the biggest year for graduating and hiring medical specialists, and that more than 25,000 IMSS-Bienestar health workers had been regularized into permanent posts. That is strong evidence of staffing through professional credentials and formal basification rather than patronage. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **IMSS-Bienestar opera en 23 entidades para atender a 53.2 millones de mexicanos que no tienen seguridad social** | IMSS | 2024-04-17 | [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202404/170) | IMSS-Bienestar was described as a federally managed public health system with 131,000 workers, 635 hospitals, and 11,913 health centers serving 53.2 million uninsured people. This supports a reading of large-scale professional administration rather than ad hoc patronage. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **ACUERDO mediante el cual se establecen las Reglas de Operación del Programa IMSS-Bienestar para el ejercicio fiscal 2024** | Diario Oficial de la Federación / IMSS | 2024 | [URL](https://sidof.segob.gob.mx/notas/docFuente/5713366) | The 2024 rules of operation say IMSS-Bienestar is administered by IMSS through specific medical, finance, and administration units and is designed to guarantee the constitutional right to health. That is strong evidence of institutionalized, rules-based management. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Reciben base laboral 339 trabajadores de la salud de IMSS-Bienestar en Tabasco** | IMSS | 2024-02-?? | [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202402/079) | IMSS said the program had already basified 27,305 health professionals and treated stable staffing as the core of quality, public, and free care. This is direct evidence of professional staffing rather than patronage hiring. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Gobierno federal amplía por 3 meses contratos a trabajadores de salud de estados no federalizados** | IMSS | 2024-06-?? | [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202406/306) | The federal government extended contracts for 1,579 health workers so their employment would not be disrupted while states decided whether to join IMSS-Bienestar. That suggests an attempt to preserve service continuity with an administrative rather than political logic. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Todos los trámites de los Programas para el Bienestar son totalmente gratuitos, te decimos cómo evitar fraudes** | Programas para el Bienestar | 2023-12-28 | [URL](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/todos-los-tramites-de-los-programas-para-el-bienestar-son-totalmente-gratuitos-te-decimos-como-evitar-fraudes/) | The Bienestar system says access is free, direct, and without intermediaries, with no one allowed to charge for registration or delivery. That is strong anti-patronage design, even though this is official self-description. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Entrega directa de Programas para el Bienestar abate la corrupción** | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-10-17 | [URL](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/) | The government argued that direct deposit to Banco del Bienestar cards eliminated intermediaries and reduced commission-taking from social programs. This is direct evidence of a delivery model meant to avoid patronage networks. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2

**Negative / Mixed**
- **Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral** | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | [URL](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | The government admitted payments were advanced ahead of the 2024 electoral blackout. That is not proof of patronage abuse, but it is patronage-sensitive timing that weakens a pure professionalism story. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Bienestar no entrega préstamos ni créditos a cuenta de los Programas del Bienestar** | Secretaría de Bienestar | 2024-07-30 | [URL](https://www.gob.mx/bienestar/prensa/bienestar-no-entrega-prestamos-ni-creditos-a-cuenta-de-los-programas-del-bienestar) | The ministry had to warn repeatedly that no official loans or cash advances were being offered via messages or intermediaries. That suggests a live fraud/intermediary risk around the program environment, even if not proof of state patronage. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Programas para el Bienestar serán constitucionales** | Presidencia de la República | 2024-10-28 | [URL](https://www.gob.mx/presidencia/prensa/programas-para-el-bienestar-seran-constitucionales-presidenta-sheinbaum) | This later 2024 material praises the constitutionalization of welfare programs and continued house visits, but it remains government framing rather than independent validation of professional management. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **Human Rights Watch: Mexico world report chapter** | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | [URL](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | HRW’s broader Mexico chapter says AMLO blocked appointments to INAI and weakened independent oversight generally. That does not directly prove patronage in social services, but it does cut against a fully professional, accountability-rich state apparatus. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2
- **IMSS-Bienestar, legado del presidente al pueblo de México, se va a consolidar en el próximo sexenio** | IMSS | 2024-09-?? | [URL](https://www.imss.gob.mx/prensa/archivo/202409/490) | IMSS says staffing and coverage expanded massively, but this is still institutional self-reporting and not an external audit of service quality, staffing competence, or absence of patronage. IDs: 6B.4, 6B.2

**Search Gap**
- I found strong official evidence for direct payments, basification, specialist hiring, and formal rules.
- I found only limited independent 2024 evidence directly evaluating whether the social-service bureaucracy was free of patronage networks.
- So the best-supported judgment is “mostly yes on professionalization, with real patronage risk at the margins and weak independent verification.”
